ImportExport.MenuHint: Export your board data to a JSON file, or import data from another world.
ImportExport.Title: Lore Board - Import / Export
ImportExport.Hint: Export saves all tabs, pins, and image references to a JSON file you can import into another world. Image paths must exist in the destination world's file structure to display correctly.
ImportExport.ExportFailed: Export failed. Check the browser console for details.
ImportExport.ParseError: Could not read the file. Make sure it is a valid JSON export from this module.
ImportExport.InvalidFile: This does not appear to be a Lore Reference Board export file.
ImportExport.ImportModeTitle: How should the data be imported?
ImportExport.ImportModeHint:
Add to Existing - Adds the imported tabs alongside your current ones without removing anything.

Replace All - Overwrites all current tabs and pins with the imported data. This cannot be undone.
ImportExport.ResetPosHint: Closes the board and clears its saved size and position. Re-open to apply the default dimensions.
ImportExport.ResetPosSuccess: Window position reset. Re-open the board to apply the default dimensions.

MaxTabRows.Name: Maximum Tab Rows
MaxTabRows.Hint: How many rows the tab bar can grow to before scrolling. Set to 0 for unlimited rows.
